about.manifesto.title: Scale Your BIM Execution Through Code, Not Headcount.
about.manifesto.lead: pyBIM provides practical BIM engineering services, multidisciplinary coordination, and model information review. We tailor engineering workflows to project requirements while drawing on specialized Revit, Python, and C# technical practices.
about.manifesto.rd_note: Alongside current delivery services, we are actively developing connected BIM automation and private AI infrastructure under internal engineering validation. Our workflows align with ISO 19650 information-management principles and incorporate UNI 11337 requirements where applicable to Italian projects, adapting to the agreed scope of each client and jurisdiction.
about.manifesto.aria_label: Engineering Evolution: From Project Delivery to Sovereign AI Infrastructure
about.manifesto.phase1_desc: Multidisciplinary BIM coordination, model information review, and project-specific technical workflows.
about.manifesto.phase2_desc: Revit-connected automation modules and repeatable workflow orchestration under technical validation.
about.manifesto.phase3_desc: Sovereign on-premises LLM inference and controlled engineering data reasoning architecture.
about.philosophy.title: Different Approaches. A Clearer Engineering Direction.
about.philosophy.subtitle: Engineering work can be approached through conventional delivery, standardized software, or an engineering-first model that gradually integrates purpose-built technology. pyBIM is building the latter.
about.philosophy.col1_primary: Conventional BIM delivery often relies on manual coordination, repeated data entry, and project-by-project review activities.
about.philosophy.col1_supporting: These methods remain valuable, but repetitive work and fragmented information exchanges can become more difficult to manage as project complexity increases.
about.philosophy.col2_primary: pyBIM focuses on practical BIM engineering, coordinated project information, and workflows shaped around real project requirements.
about.philosophy.col2_supporting: Alongside current engineering work, we are developing and testing connected automation, custom software capabilities, and private AI infrastructure for future use.
about.philosophy.col2_status_note: New capabilities will be introduced following development and technical validation.
about.philosophy.col3_primary: Established BIM and software platforms provide useful capabilities through standardized features and predefined workflows.
about.philosophy.col3_supporting: For highly specific requirements, teams may still need additional integration, project-specific configuration, or engineering support.
about.journey.title: The Evolution from Manual Coordination to Tech-Enabled Execution.
about.journey.p1_item1_desc: Managing complex European infrastructure projects exposed a critical industry failure. Highly skilled engineers waste up to 40% of their billable hours on repetitive data entry, parameter mapping, and manual quality control.
about.journey.p1_item2_desc: Relying on brute-force human labor mathematically guarantees data errors during high-stakes B2B tenders, draining project budgets and jeopardizing ISO 19650 compliance.
about.journey.p2_item1_desc: Operating from the tech hub of Padua, Italy, we transformed our methodology. We stopped scaling by traditional headcount and transitioned entirely to execution code.
about.journey.p2_item2_desc: By developing custom C# and Python APIs for Revit, we automated clash matrices and parameter audits. We now deliver complex BIM projects with an 80% reduction in turnaround time and absolute zero-error precision.
about.journey.p3_item1_desc: To handle massive metadata validation at an enterprise scale, we engineered proprietary Edge AI appliances deployed directly within our clients' corporate LANs.
about.journey.p3_item2_desc: Zero public cloud exposure. We guarantee strict data sovereignty and algorithmic certainty for the most demanding structural engineering firms in Europe.
about.tech.title: Engineered for Output, Not Effort.
about.tech.desc: Eliminating manual bottlenecks through tech-enabled project execution, custom algorithmic infrastructure, and Sovereign AI deployment.
about.tech.box1_sub: Enterprise-grade authoring and clash coordination. We execute your complex models with zero geometric and data conflicts before they reach the site.
about.tech.box2_sub: Algorithmic control over manual workflows. We replace redundant human effort with scalable C# and Python code infrastructure.

about.team.sec1.title: Engineering the Execution. Deploying the Infrastructure.

Spontaneous technical submissions for future engineering roles are continuously audited via our strict code-first hiring protocol.
